title: Throughput Bank: credit-backed reservations, autoscale DSL, and approval templates
creator: Alyssa Chen
description:
Problem: Customers buying Dedicated capacity want predictable throughput SLAs but also need burst capacity for traffic spikes. Current reservation flow is binary (reserve X throughput permanently) and lacks flexible crediting or a policy language for mixed reserved/burst behavior. This ticket proposes the "Throughput Bank": a credit-escrow model for reservations combined with an autoscale DSL that operators and customers can author. The Throughput Bank lets teams escrow 'throughput credits' that are burned by actual usage, supports scheduled top-ups, and exposes a policy surface for: (a) guaranteed baseline throughput, (b) prioritized burst borrowing from pooled capacity, (c) fallback model variants under contention, and (d) billing/chargeback rules for credit overdraft.

Deliverables:
- Product spec (Confluence) and approval templates for finance/CS to sign credit-backed reservations
- Autoscale policy DSL v1 and a validation UI in the Console for customers to preview expected latency/cost tradeoffs
- API endpoints for submitting credit-backed reservation requests and querying bank balances
- Approval workflow templates (auto-approve thresholds vs manual review) and audit log hooks
- Integration tests and a dashboard showing live escrow utilization, overdraft events, and SLA violations

Key trade-offs and decisions:
- Banked credits vs hard reservations: credits increase flexibility (customers can smooth peaks), but complicate forecasting and billing. We will cap overdraft and enforce minimum baseline guarantees to protect other tenants.
- DSL complexity: keep v1 intentionally small (5 policy primitives) to reduce surface area. More advanced primitives (time-based decay, geo-priority) reserved for future cycles.
- Routing & fairness: when pooled capacity is scarce, policy priority determines access; we will implement soft isolation windows before any hard throttling.

Stakeholders: Product (Ravi, Alyssa), Infra/Serving Runtime (Kendall Rivera), Billing (Priya Nambiar), Security/Compliance (Marco Li), Solutions Eng (Jules Park).

acceptance_criteria: 1) Customers can submit credit-backed reservation requests via API and Console. 2) Autoscale DSL v1 supports baseline, burst cap, priority, overdraft cap, and scheduled top-ups. 3) Console shows projected latency and monthly cost for a policy before approval. 4) Approval templates enforce auto-approve rules and generate audit logs. 5) Dashboard surfaces live escrow balance, overdraft events, and correlated SLA breaches.
